segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to complete an initial Business Combination with a target business; it has no operating revenues.
segments.evidence: The CODM assesses performance for the single segment and decides how to allocate resources.

revenueModel.text: The company has no customers and no operating revenue; it earns nothing from sales before its initial Business Combination.
revenueModel.evidence: We have generated no operating revenues to date and we do not expect that we will generate operating revenues until we consummate our initial Business Combination.
